Fictional English derivative family evidence
All people, places and facts in this packet are invented for engineering tests.

[ORIGIN-01 | evidence root fictional-ledger:F005]
The fictional family ledger places Alder Vale's birth and lifetime residence in Willowford, Northmere.

[TIME-01 | evidence root fictional-ledger:F005]
The fictional family ledger records Alder Vale as born about 1885 and deceased about 1961. Both years are approximate.

[MOVEMENT-01 | evidence root fictional-ledger:F015]
The fictional family ledger places Ellis Vale in Willowford until about 1936, then in Harbourfield from about 1936 to 1980. The exact moving date is unknown.

[CONFLICT-01 | evidence root fictional-ledger:F017]
Clara Vale's fictional ledger birth field gives 1911. Its margin note reports 1909. No original birth certificate is supplied; keep the year unresolved.

[KINSHIP-01 | evidence root fictional-ledger:FR039]
The fictional relationship ledger identifies Martin Vale as the father of Jonah Vale. Raw rows 39 and 46 repeat the same link; retain FR039 once.
